sources.label: Wikipedia, "55 Cancri Ad"
sources.quote: 55 Cancri Ad, formally named Lipperhey, is an extrasolar planet in a long-period orbit around the Sun-like star 55 Cancri A. If confirmed, it would be at a similar distance from its star as Jupiter is from the Sun, and the fifth and outermost known planet in its planetary system.

introduction.text: It is one of 5 planets known around 55 Cnc. Its orbit, tilt included, follows Xiao et al. 2026's fit, and its size is the archive's model from its mass.
